decisions.reason: The position requires fabrication, supply, and installation of a complete aeration system, including its compressor unit and support frame.

items.material_name: Single-storey high-performance crossflow water aeration system, 11 L/s, 2300 × 1350 × 650 mm, with 400 V process-air compressor unit (400 Nm³/h at 50 mbar, 2.2 kW reference) and grade 1.4301 stainless steel support frame
items.description: Complete aeration package with inlet, reaction and outlet modules, a sound-insulated variable-speed compressor unit, and a 22 kN support frame.

decisions.reason: The position requires supply and installation of a complete air filter unit; the filter elements and mounting accessories are included.

items.material_name: Two-stage inline air filter unit, grade 1.4571 stainless steel, DN 200 interfaces, minimum 900 m³/h, F7 and H13 filters, 800 Pa filter burst pressure
items.description: Serviceable filter housing with differential pressure monitoring, condensate drains, and wall mounting brackets.

decisions.reason: The position requires supply and installation of new exterior ventilation louvers with included screens, adapters, and fixings.

items.material_name: Fixed-blade exterior weather louver, grade 1.4571 stainless steel, DN 200 duct adapter, minimum 900 m³/h, for approximately 200 mm wall thickness
items.description: Rain-resistant wall louver with welded overlapping Z-blades, removable 1 × 1 mm insect screen, and tamper-resistant mounting.
